reviews.review:
The end is here yet the grind doesn't stop.
If you ever wanted to play a souls like game with guns, this is the one.
At this point the game is out with all its dlc and final content, but its still breathing and is fun.
The difficulty is 6 out of 10 for newbies, real grindy. Will clock couple of hundred hours easily.
This game is a nod to its predecessor, improving it in all the ways.
The game is not perfect but is a finished product.
This game feels well made and balanced, where it shines is the community with insane activity to help each other.

Pros
Guns feel alive, feel different
well though classes and items to make builts
coop is fun and meaningful.

cons
There is no ingame voice or text chat
The new prism system is ♥♥♥♥, feels like the devs just threw their hats and said - roll the dice and be a God
Cross platform gameplay sometimes feels a hastle
Performance issues with some maps

Verdict
The game is finished yet not complete, feels a couple of patches should do it. Anyone planning on to buy the game can feel daunting with the content but everything is achievable in time. No PAY TO WIN aspects. Get all stuff through gameplay
If u looking for a souls type game with guns. This is the one.

Is your teacher going to say you performed great this semester if you got 100% grading on all of your homework but every piece of paper was signed by someone else than you? No?

Then why the ♥♥♥♥ should I be happy with a game that requires DLSS/FSR upscaling to actually perform over 60FPS at 1080p low settings on a mid-tier PC? Sod off.

Game itself is actually fun, especially with friends. Still cannot recommend it considering the ridiculous performance issues.

So..after over 200 hours later here is my honest review. 
I managed to finish the game on every difficulty ( except hardcore ) and I obtained 99 % of the items in the game.
Remnant II definitely worth to buy and play. It is a really fun but also challenging game. It can be annoying and frustrating to obtain the items you want to have because it doesn't always spawns in the world / adventure you're currently in but it is not impossible..after all the best items worth the grind.
The game visually is 9/10, gameplay is 10/10, storyline 10/10.

What I would've loved to have is a chat system. Sometimes you want to get a specific item / trait ( leech for example ) where you need another player to finish and if you can't communicate with that random person is a bit hard..
Other than that, I think Remnant II has everything you can ask for.

I will uninstall the game after this review because I am not going to get the hardcore items because I don't feel like I need them so I can't really do anything else in the game. 
I bought all the 3 DLC's and finished them all multiple times. 

In my opinion everyone should play this game once in a lifetime.

PS : If anyone needs help with a specific item or they can't beat a map / boss, let me know and we can do it together.

Lot of Crashes and Bugs since DLC3.
Killed my Savegames - all chars gone.

Solution crashes:
Deinstall  the game
update MB and GFX drivers
ReInstall the game

No more problems during bossrushes or on startup

Solution restore last savegame (damaged after chrash):
Edit Savegamefolder: C:\Users\info\Saved Games\Remnant2\Steam\
remove profile.sav,  save_0.sav, save_1.sav
copy profile.bak3 as parofle.save
copy save_0.bak3 as save_0.sav
copy save_1.bak3 as save_1.sav

Game runs very well again
Remnant 2 is more of everything you loved in Remnant 1, so if you've beaten the game and you still want more then buy Remnant 2, it's well worth it.
